review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped for uses of kostantRootSubgroupMatrix across the repo. The file has one simp lemma, kostantRootSubgroupMatrix_apply. It rewrites a matrix entry of the bundled homomorphism into a coordinate of the action. The left side is a head-constant application, and the right side does not contain it, so I see no rewrite cycle. The other lemmas, kostantRootSubgroupMatrix_def and map_kostantRootSubgroupMatrix, are not simp. That seems deliberate: the def lemma would unfold the definition, and the naturality lemma would compete with the apply lemma. The sampled downstream uses call the lemmas with rw, so I found no concrete expression where the current simp set gives a bad normal form or where a missing simp rule would help. I did not check every use of the apply lemma, and I could not run Lean.
